entities.summary: Mats Jonsson is a rally driver from Sweden. He competed in the World Rally Championship from 1984 to 1993, with a best position of 12th overall in the 1991 season. His greatest individual events were in his home Swedish Rally, which he won outright in successive years in 1992 and 1993. He has won the Swedish rally championship 17 times. Mats Jonsson was a architects & engineers from Karlstad Municipality (b. 1957-11-28, Karlstad Municipality). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
